method: Unchanged original classes on MobMoveProbe/ChickenProbe world double. Spider subclass supplies brightness/water state and intercepts outgoing melee damage. Seeded dropFewItems captures actual spawned string/eye stacks including RNG consumption by dropped entities. attackEntity records daylight target loss, leaps, cooldown and hits. ModelSpider.setRotationAngles runs without rendering. moveEntityWithHeading with forward 0 and motionZ reset to 0.22 each step; climbing flag follows horizontal collision after each tick, as EntitySpider.onUpdate. Flat floor or wall z >= 2, height 6. Swimming: yaw 0, forward 0.8f * 0.98f from y 10 for 40 steps.
